title.en: First step on a shortest route

brief.zh: 写一个 shortest_step(board, start, goal) 函数。坐标用 [x, y]，井号是墙，圆点是地板。返回一条最短路线的第一步。没有路或已经到了就返回 None。
brief.en: Write shortest_step(board, start, goal). Coordinates are [x, y], # is a wall, and . is the floor. Return the first step on a shortest route, or None if there is no route or you are already there.

hints.zh: 把队列里的每格记成 [x, y, first]，其中 first 是从起点出发时的第一步。
hints.en: Store [x, y, first] in each queue entry. The value first records the first move from the start.

hints.zh: 每次从队首取格子。按上、右、下、左检查相邻格，略过墙、边界和已经访问过的格子。
hints.en: Take from the front. Check up, right, down, then left and skip walls, edges, and visited cells.

hints.zh: 新格子是终点时，返回记录的第一步。队列空了就没有路线。
hints.en: Return the stored first move when a new cell is the goal. An empty queue means there is no route.
